"""Hand-written validation / error-code / precedence tests."""
import json
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/submission')
import main as impl

OK = 'OK'
EJ = '{"ok":false,"error":"E_JSON"}'
ES = '{"ok":false,"error":"E_SCHEMA"}'
EL = '{"ok":false,"error":"E_LIMIT"}'
EC = '{"ok":false,"error":"E_COMPLEXITY"}'


def req(services=None, rules=None, queries=None, **extra):
    base = {'services': services if services is not None else ['a', 'b'],
            'rules': rules if rules is not None else [],
            'queries': queries if queries is not None else []}
    base.update(extra)
    return base


CASES = []


def case(raw, expected, note=''):
    CASES.append((raw, expected, note))


# --- E_JSON ---------------------------------------------------------------
case(b'', EJ, 'blank line')
case(b'   ', EJ, 'whitespace only')
case(b'\xff\xfe', EJ, 'invalid utf-8')
case(b'[1,2,', EJ, 'truncated')
case(b'{"services":[],"rules":[],"queries":[],"queries":[]}', EJ, 'duplicate key')
case(b'{"services":[],"rules":[],"queries":[],"zz":NaN}', EJ, 'NaN')
case(b'{"services":[],"rules":[],"queries":[],"zz":Infinity}', EJ, 'Infinity')
case(b'{"services":[],"rules":[],"queries":[],"zz":-Infinity}', EJ, '-Infinity')
case(b'01', EJ, 'leading zero')
case(b"'x'", EJ, 'single quotes')
case(b'{"services":[],}', EJ, 'trailing comma')
case(b'{"services":["\\ud800"],"rules":[],"queries":[]}', ES, 'lone surrogate escape')
case(b'{"services":["a\\u0000b"],"rules":[],"queries":[]}', OK, 'NUL escape in service name')
case(b'{"services":["\\ud83d\\ude00"],"rules":[],"queries":[]}', OK, 'surrogate pair escape')

# --- E_LIMIT stage 1/2 ----------------------------------------------------
case(b'[' * 65, EL, 'depth 65 of one kind')
case(b'{' * 65, EL, 'depth 65 braces')
case(b'[[' * 33, EL, 'unbalanced depth')
case(('[1,' * 64).encode(), EJ, 'depth 64 then junk -> invalid json')
case(b'a' * 1048577, EL, 'line over byte limit')
case(b'x' * 1048576, EJ, 'line at byte limit but not json')

# --- E_SCHEMA --------------------------------------------------------------
case(b'[]', ES, 'not an object')
case(b'null', ES, 'null')
case(b'"text"', ES, 'string')
case(b'5', ES, 'number')
case(b'true', ES, 'boolean')
case(b'{"services":[],"rules":[]}', ES, 'missing key')
case(json.dumps(req(extra={'zz': 1})).encode(), ES, 'extra key')
case(json.dumps(req(services={})).encode(), ES, 'services not list')
case(json.dumps(req(services=[1])).encode(), ES, 'service not string')
case(json.dumps(req(services=[True])).encode(), ES, 'service boolean')
case(json.dumps(req(services=['a', 'a'])).encode(), ES, 'duplicate service')
case(json.dumps(req(services=[''])).encode(), ES, 'empty service')

case(json.dumps(req(rules=[{'action': 'drop ' 'x', 'when': {'op': 'true'}}])).encode(), ES, 'bad action text')

case(json.dumps(req(services=['a' * 65])).encode(), EL, '65-scalar service name')
case(json.dumps(req(services=['a' * 64])).encode(), OK, '64-scalar service name')
case(json.dumps(req(rules=[{'action': 'allow', 'when': {'op': 'true'}}] * 33)).encode(), EL, '33 rules')
case(json.dumps(req(rules=[{'action': 'allow', 'when': {'op': 'true'}}] * 32)).encode(), OK, '32 rules')
case(json.dumps(req(rules=[{'action': 'allow', 'when': {'op': 'and', 'args': [
    {'op': 'true'}] * 33}}])).encode(), EL, '33 args')
case(json.dumps(req(rules=[{'action': 'allow', 'when': {'op': 'and', 'args': [
    {'op': 'true'}] * 32}}])).encode(), OK, '32 args')
case(json.dumps(req(rules=[{'action': 'allow', 'when': {'op': 'match',
                                                        'path': ['a'] * 17}}])).encode(),
     EL, '17-token atom path')
case(json.dumps(req(rules=[{'action': 'allow', 'when': {'op': 'match',
                                                        'path': ['a'] * 16}}])).encode(),
     OK, '16-token atom path')
# 11 distinct atoms
many = [{'action': 'allow',
         'when': {'op': 'contains', 'path': ['a'] * 3 + ['b'] * 0 + ['a' if i % 2 else 'b']}}
        for i in range(11)]
many = []
for i in range(11):
    path = ['a'] * (i % 3) + (['b'] if i % 2 else []) + (['a'] if i >= 6 else [])
    if not path:
        path = ['b'] * (i + 1)
    many.append({'action': 'allow', 'when': {'op': 'contains', 'path': path}})
case(json.dumps(req(rules=many)).encode(), EL, '11 distinct atoms')
case(json.dumps(req(rules=many[:10])).encode(), OK, '10 distinct atoms')
# repeated identical atoms count once -> ok
same = [{'action': 'allow', 'when': {'op': 'contains', 'path': ['a', 'b']}}] * 11
case(json.dumps(req(rules=same)).encode(), OK, '11 rules one atom')
# 257 expression nodes
deep = {'op': 'true'}
for _ in range(256):
    deep = {'op': 'not', 'arg': deep}
case(json.dumps(req(rules=[{'action': 'allow', 'when': deep}])).encode(), EL, '257 nodes')
deep2 = {'op': 'true'}
for _ in range(255):
    deep2 = {'op': 'not', 'arg': deep2}
case(json.dumps(req(rules=[{'action': 'allow', 'when': deep2}])).encode(), OK, '256 nodes')
# queries
case(json.dumps(req(queries=[[]] * 257)).encode(), EL, '257 queries')
case(json.dumps(req(queries=[[]] * 256)).encode(), OK, '256 queries')
case(json.dumps(req(queries=[['a'] * 4097])).encode(), EL, '4097-token query')
case(json.dumps(req(queries=[['a'] * 4096])).encode(), OK, '4096-token query')

case(json.dumps(req(queries=[['a'] * 4096, []])).encode(), OK, '4096 total query tokens')

# --- precedence ------------------------------------------------------------
case(json.dumps(req(services=['s%d' % i for i in range(25)], queries=[['zz']])).encode(),
     ES, 'schema beats size')
case(json.dumps(req(rules=many, queries=[['zz']])).encode(), ES, 'schema beats size (atoms)')
case(json.dumps(req(rules=many, services=['s%d' % i for i in range(25)])).encode(),
     EL, 'size beats complexity')
case(b'[' * 70 + b'@@@', EL, 'depth beats invalid json')
case(b'\xff' + b'[' * 70, EJ, 'utf-8 beats depth scan')

big = {'services': ['a', 'b'],
       'rules': [{'action': 'allow',
                  'when': {'op': 'and', 'args': [
                      {'op': 'contains', 'path': ['a' if (i + j) % 2 else 'b'] * 16}
                      for j in range(10) for i in range(1)][:10]}}],
       'queries': []}

case(json.dumps(req(services=[], queries=None and [] or [[]])).encode(), OK, 'empty alphabet')
case(b'{"services":["a"],"rules":[{"action":"allow","when":{"op":"startswith","path":[]}}],"queries":[["a"],["a","a"],[]]}',
     OK, 'empty pattern startswith')


def main():
    failures = 0
    for raw, expected, note in CASES:

        if expected == OK:
            good = got.startswith('{"ok":true') and got.endswith('}')
        else:
            good = (got == expected)
        if not good:
            failures += 1
            print('FAIL %-40s expected=%s got=%s' % (note, expected[:40], got[:80]))
    print('%d cases, %d failures' % (len(CASES), failures))
    return 1 if failures else 0


if __name__ == '__main__':
    raise SystemExit(main())
